description: Quantify HID1 AlphaFold fold: helix content, antiparallel helix stacking, elongation, and N-terminal amphipathic/basic membrane features
code:
import requests, json, collections
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"research-agent/1.0"}
pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8IV36-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=180).text
seq_up=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8IV36.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text
SEQ="".join(seq_up.split("\n")[1:])
atoms=collections.defaultdict(dict)
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        n=int(l[22:26]); atoms[n][l[12:16].strip()]=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
N=max(atoms)
CA=np.array([atoms[i]["CA"][:3] for i in range(1,N+1)])
plddt=np.array([atoms[i]["CA"][3] for i in range(1,N+1)])

# --- SS from CA geometry (same rule as before) ---
def dist(i,j): return np.linalg.norm(CA[i]-CA[j])
ss=np.array(["C"]*N,dtype="<U1")
for i in range(N-4):
    if 4.6<=dist(i,i+3)<=6.3 and 5.0<=dist(i,i+4)<=7.0 and 5.0<=dist(i,i+2)<=6.4: ss[i:i+5]="H"
segs=[];cur=None
for i,c in enumerate(ss):
    if c=="H" and cur is None: cur=i
    elif c!="H" and cur is not None:
        if i-cur>=7: segs.append((cur,i-1))
        cur=None
if cur is not None and N-cur>=7: segs.append((cur,N-1))

# --- helix axes & inter-helix geometry ---
def axis(a,b):
    P=CA[a:b+1]; c=P.mean(0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); v=vt[0]
    if np.dot(P[-1]-P[0],v)<0: v=-v
    return c,v,np.linalg.norm(P[-1]-P[0])
info=[axis(a,b) for a,b in segs]
rows=[]
for k in range(len(segs)-1):
    c1,v1,_=info[k]; c2,v2,_=info[k+1]
    ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(abs(np.dot(v1,v2)),-1,1)))
    signed=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(v1,v2),-1,1)))
    rows.append((segs[k][0]+1,segs[k][1]+1,segs[k+1][0]+1,segs[k+1][1]+1,signed,np.linalg.norm(c1-c2)))
anti=[r for r in rows if r[4]>120]
print(f"helices (>=7 res): {len(segs)}; consecutive pairs: {len(rows)}")
print(f"antiparallel pairs (angle>120 deg): {len(anti)}/{len(rows)} = {len(anti)/len(rows):.2f}")
print(f"median consecutive-helix centroid distance: {np.median([r[5] for r in rows]):.1f} A")

# --- overall shape: principal axes of residues 1-600 vs 690-788 ---
def shape(lo,hi):
    P=CA[lo-1:hi]; P=P-P.mean(0); ev=np.linalg.svd(P,compute_uv=False)**2/len(P)
    rg=np.sqrt(ev.sum()); 
    return rg, np.sqrt(ev[0]/ev[2]), np.sqrt(ev)
for lab,lo,hi in [("full 1-788",1,788),("N+core 1-600",1,600),("core 300-570",300,570),("Cterm 690-788",690,788)]:
    rg,ar,ev=shape(lo,hi)
    n=hi-lo+1
    rg_glob=2.2*n**0.38   # Flory-type globular expectation
    print(f"{lab:<15} n={n:<4} Rg={rg:6.1f} A (globular expect {rg_glob:5.1f})  axial ratio={ar:4.2f}")

# --- N-terminal amphipathicity / basic patch ---
kd={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def muH(s,delta=100.0):
    a=np.radians(delta)*np.arange(len(s)); h=np.array([kd[c] for c in s])
    return np.hypot((h*np.cos(a)).sum(),(h*np.sin(a)).sum())/len(s)
def charge(s): return sum(c in "KR" for c in s)-sum(c in "DE" for c in s)
w=11
mu=np.array([muH(SEQ[i:i+w]) for i in range(N-w+1)])
chg=np.array([charge(SEQ[i:i+w]) for i in range(N-w+1)])
print("\nN-terminal 1-30:", SEQ[:30])
print(f"  mu_H(2-20) = {muH(SEQ[1:20]):.3f} ; net charge(2-20) = {charge(SEQ[1:20])}")
print(f"  genome-wide-ish percentile of mu_H(2-12) among all 11-mers of HID1: {(mu < muH(SEQ[1:12])).mean():.3f}")
top=np.argsort(-mu)[:8]
print("  top-8 amphipathic 11-mers (start res, muH, charge, seq):")
for i in sorted(top): print(f"    {i+1:>4} muH={mu[i]:.3f} q={chg[i]:+d} {SEQ[i:i+w]}")
print("  most basic 11-mers:")
for i in sorted(np.argsort(-chg)[:8]): print(f"    {i+1:>4} q={chg[i]:+d} muH={mu[i]:.3f} {SEQ[i:i+w]}")

# ---- FIGURE ----
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,9))
ax=fig.add_subplot(3,1,1)
ax.plot(np.arange(1,N+1),plddt,lw=0.9,color="#2a6ebb")
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
for a,b in segs: ax.axvspan(a+1,b+1,color="#f2a900",alpha=0.25,lw=0)
ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_xlim(1,N)
ax.set_title("HID1 (Q8IV36) AlphaFold model: pLDDT and helices (orange), 33 helices, 63% helical")
for x,lab in [(600,"600"),(690,"690")]: ax.axvline(x,color="k",lw=0.8)
ax.text(300,20,"alpha-solenoid core (1-600)",ha="center"); ax.text(740,20,"C-term 690-788",ha="center")

ax=fig.add_subplot(3,1,2)
ax.plot(np.arange(1,N-w+2)+w//2,mu,lw=0.9,color="#2a6ebb",label="hydrophobic moment (11-mer)")
ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.plot(np.arange(1,N-w+2)+w//2,chg,lw=0.9,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.7,label="net charge (11-mer)")
ax.set_ylabel("mu_H"); ax2.set_ylabel("net charge"); ax.set_xlim(1,N)
ax.axvspan(2,20,color="green",alpha=0.2)
ax.set_title("Amphipathicity and charge along HID1; green band = myristoylated N-terminal helix 2-20")

ax=fig.add_subplot(3,1,3)
cent=np.array([c for c,_,_ in info])
ax.plot(range(len(rows)),[r[4] for r in rows],"o-",color="#2a6ebb")
ax.axhline(120,ls="--",c="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("consecutive helix pair index"); ax.set_ylabel("inter-helix angle (deg)")
ax.set_title(f"Consecutive helix pairs: {len(anti)}/{len(rows)} antiparallel (>120 deg), median centroid spacing {np.median([r[5] for r in rows]):.1f} A")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
globals()['SEQ']=SEQ; globals()['SEGS']=segs
